assumptions.choice: A sideways range is evaluated from the 20 completed candles preceding the breakout candle.
assumptions.reason: The specification requires support and resistance with at least two touches but does not specify a lookback period; 20 periods is used consistently with the stated SMA and volume periods.

assumptions.choice: A support or resistance touch is a low or high within 0.5% of the respective range extreme; at least two such touches are required.
assumptions.reason: The specification requires two touches but does not define an equality tolerance for market prices.

assumptions.choice: The 20-period average volume uses the 20 completed candles preceding the breakout candle.
assumptions.reason: This measures breakout volume against prior volume rather than including the breakout candle itself.

assumptions.choice: Market entry orders are submitted on the breakout candle and execute at the next candle open under standard backtrader behavior.
assumptions.reason: The specification permits entry at the open of the next candle.

assumptions.choice: Position size may be fractional and equals 1% of current broker value divided by the distance from breakout close to stop-loss.
assumptions.reason: The next opening price is unknown when the market order is submitted; the breakout close is the available entry-price estimate.
